project.name: VolstruisGids
project.tagline: Klein Karoo se markplein – koop, verkoop, adverteer
project.description: Local classifieds + notices platform replacing two high-traffic WhatsApp groups (Oudtshoorn–Calitzdorp–Ladismith–Van Wyksdorp–Zoar)

core_features: Promotions (Top Category 7 days + Top Section 30 days)
Free tier limit: maximum 5 posts per day for personal users
Business listings in separate higher-visibility section
Notices / Questions section: post info or ask questions → replies via DM only

monetisation.business_ads: separate section with badge and priority
monetisation.promotions: top of category (7 days) or top of section (30 days)
monetisation.visibility: paid top spots for faster sales and more views

phases.name: Skeleton
phases.description: Create exact folder structure + run.py + requirements.txt + basic app/__init__.py

phases.name: Config + Database + Models
phases.description: config.py, all models.py files, Flask-Migrate setup

phases.name: Auth Blueprint
phases.description: Full auth routes + forms + login required decorator

phases.name: Create & View Listings
phases.description: Post ad form + photo upload + detail view

phases.name: Promotions & PayFast
phases.description: Buy top spot flow with placeholders

rules.build_guarantee: After every change, run the app and prove it starts with ZERO errors
